finding.title: Source-only ingestion can replace the global default with an unrelated-cache-dependent partial candidate
mechanism: pipeline.ingest builds items from selected extraction plus whichever caches match current runtime/config; no pinned published base is merged
validateIngestCandidate checks internal integrity and counts but does not compare scope or unrelated records with current publication
publishIngestCandidate calls setDefaultPublication on any technically valid ingested candidate
QA workflow checks source parse, resume/idempotence and old-history visibility; these do not prove unrelated source retention in the new default
finding.effect: A partial candidate may be structurally valid and explicitly labelled incomplete, yet publishing it as default can remove other sources from unpinned public queries. Prior snapshot remains immutable and recoverable.

acceptance.mechanical_scope: Can demonstrate genuine parse + pause/restart/resume + private preparation + explicit version exposure + rollback
acceptance.global_update_scope: Not demonstrated by a partial-source candidate; remains pending
acceptance.gate: ingestionScopeErrors rejects partial-candidate or missing preservation evidence independently of passed=true

recommendation.source_update: Pin base publication at enqueue, merge only selected source revision and dependent links/ancestors into the immutable base, preserve all unrelated records and coverage
recommendation.full_rebuild: Alternatively require a complete validated prepared artifact with explicit scope reconciliation against baseline/inventory before default promotion
recommendation.publication: Show exact additions/changes/removals and disappeared source/UF/stage/components before decision; atomically compare expected default/base when publishing
recommendation.verification: Compare canonical hashes and counts for every untargeted source, all relationships not touching target, and unaffected coverage. Verify the actual publication event replaced the pinned base. Keep prior-publication immutability/history checks as a separate proof.
